description: This Scala source file defines an abstract class 'DataFrameStatFunctions' providing statistical functions for Spark DataFrames, including approximate quantiles, covariance, correlation, contingency tables, frequent item detection, stratified sampling, and sketching techniques like CountMinSketch and BloomFilter.

classes.name: DataFrameStatFunctions
classes.description: An abstract class providing statistical functions for DataFrames, including quantiles, covariance, correlation, contingency tables, frequent items, stratified sampling, and sketching.

methods.name: approxQuantile
methods.description: Calculates approximate quantiles for a single numerical column, with a specified relative error.

methods.name: approxQuantile
methods.description: Calculates approximate quantiles for multiple numerical columns, returning an array of arrays.

methods.name: cov
methods.description: Computes the covariance between two numerical columns.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Calculates the Pearson correlation coefficient between two columns.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Calculates the Pearson correlation coefficient between two columns, defaulting to 'pearson'.

methods.name: crosstab
methods.description: Generates a contingency table (pair-wise frequency table) for two columns.

methods.name: freqItems
methods.description: Finds frequent items in specified columns with a support threshold, possibly with false positives.

methods.name: sampleBy
methods.description: Performs stratified sampling without replacement based on a fraction per stratum, over a column or struct of columns.

methods.name: countMinSketch
methods.description: Builds a CountMinSketch over a specified column with given parameters.

methods.name: bloomFilter
methods.description: Builds a Bloom filter over a specified column with expected items and false positive probability.
